# JCRM Technologies (Jain CRM)

> JCRM Technologies (widely searched as Jain CRM) is an Indian engineering education, enterprise ERP software, and placement assistance company dedicated to empowering developers, institutions, and businesses with production-grade technology solutions.

Website: https://www.jcrm.in
Canonical URL: https://www.jcrm.in/
Headquarters: Chak Goraiya, Sikhar, Uttar Pradesh 231306, India
Contact Email: hr@jcrm.in
Contact Phone: +91 8310531309

---

## About JCRM Technologies
JCRM Technologies bridges the gap between academic theory and enterprise engineering. We operate dual divisions:
1. **Engineering Education & Placement**: Project-based training and 100% placement assistance programs designed and mentored by top 1% industry professionals.
2. **Enterprise ERP Solutions**: Robust, scalable cloud ERP platforms tailored for educational institutes, healthcare organizations, coaching centers, and commercial enterprises.

---

## Core Offerings

### 1. Job-Oriented Engineering Training & Internship Programs
- **Frontend Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, high-performance UI engineering.
- **Backend Development**: Java Spring Boot, Node.js, Microservices, PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka.
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Neural Networks, PyTorch, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG pipelines, MLOps.
- **Data Science**: Python, Pandas, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, predictive modeling & warehousing.
- **Cyber Security**: Ethical hacking, VAPT, SOC operations, network penetration testing, SIEM.
- **Forensic Science**: Digital forensics, disk & memory analysis, cyber incident investigation.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes orchestration, Terraform IaC, CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- **QA Automation**: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST API test automation.
- **Digital Marketing**: AI-driven performance marketing, SEO, Meta & Google Ads.
- **Zen AI**: Autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering, multi-agent enterprise workflows.

**Placement Highlights:**
- 100% Placement Support with resume building, mock interviews, and direct HR referrals.
- Trainees placed at top tech leaders including Tech Mahindra, Deloitte, Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, LTI Mindtree, HDFC Bank, Cisco, and Apexon.

### 2. Enterprise Cloud ERP Products
- **Institute & Academy LMS ERP**: End-to-end management covering student admissions, fee automation with GST billing, live virtual classes, parent portal, and automated WhatsApp notifications.
- **Coaching & Test-Prep Academy ERP**: Online mock exam engine, batch scheduling, installment tracker, digital study material distribution, and performance analytics.
- **Healthcare & Hospital ERP**: NABH-compliant hospital software for OPD/IPD queues, Electronic Health Records (EHR), pharmacy batch inventory, and diagnostic lab LIMS.
- **Polyclinic & Pharmacy Chain ERP**: Multi-doctor queue management, e-prescriptions, expiry alerts, and GST billing.
- **Specialized Business ERP Modules**: HR & Payroll Management, Gym Management, Cab Booking Dispatch, E-Commerce Portals, and AI Chatbot integrations.

### 3. Digital Growth & SEO Services
- **AI-Powered SEO Packages**: Structured data, LLM crawler optimization (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot), technical audit remediation, and localized search visibility.
- **Social Media Management**: Strategic multi-channel presence on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
